officialLinks.label: Grading system; GPA formula; excluded grades; bachelor GPA

helpIntro: Iowa State uses a 4.00 scale with plus/minus grades. Enter ISU semester credits and final grades to estimate current, cumulative, projected, and target GPA.
helpNote: Transfer grades do not enter the ISU cumulative GPA. Repeat Impact is only a planning estimate for an eligible two-attempt, same-credit ISU repeat within the 18-credit designated-repeat limit; graduate and professional records need separate review.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12.00 quality points and a 3-credit B+ earns 9.99; together, 21.99 ÷ 6 = 3.665.

gradeExplanations.F: F earns 0.00 quality points and its credits count in the GPA denominator.
gradeExplanations.P: Pass under P-NP; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.NP: Not Pass under P-NP; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete; excluded until resolved to a final grade.
gradeExplanations.X: Official drop mark; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.N: No report; not a final grade and may later convert to F under university policy.

specialTypes.name: Iowa State course
specialTypes.note: Use for standard ISU undergraduate courses on the university grading system.

specialTypes.name: External transfer course
specialTypes.note: Transfer grades may earn accepted credit but do not enter the Iowa State cumulative GPA.

repeatPolicy.note: Use Repeat Impact only for an eligible Iowa State repeat within your 18-credit designated-repeat limit and when the two attempts use the same credits. The most recent ISU attempt can lower GPA; beyond the limit, or for changed-credit/course-number cases, confirm treatment with the Registrar.
